title: Intake spam scoring: classify after capture, never reject
description: Design: docs/INTAKE_SPAM.md (Ryan approved the eight decisions on 2026-10-21). Implementation: a deterministic layer-1 scorer (server/intake-spam.ts, rules in config/intake-spam-rules.json, rules version stored with every result) runs after the durable inbox write for the engage form and every waitlist form. Each inquiry stores spam_check (score, verdict, reasons, counts-only evidence, rules version). In label mode a likely_spam inquiry is filed with the likely-spam label and no follow-up date; spam is human-only and moves to Closed, kept until deletion is requested; vendor is a separate human label. Filled honeypots are stored and labelled, not dropped. Optional elapsed_ms timing is accepted. The deployment flag spamLabelling starts as shadow (score and store only). The CRM shows the result and offers Not spam / Spam / Vendor corrections recorded in custom.spam_review; the pipeline hides likely-spam and spam behind an N hidden toggle. Jev/Cyclotron layer 2 stays off. A valid message is always accepted with the normal response; any scorer error is clean.
